name: Negative Space in Photography: Give Meaning Room to Breathe
description: Explore negative space in photography through framing, light and restraint. Compare practical examples and learn how space supports what you want to communicate.

step.name: Notice what attracts you
step.text: 01 Notice what attracts you Choose a scene and identify what attracts you: an object, a gap, a relationship or a feeling.

step.name: Make three versions
step.text: 02 Make three versions Make a spacious frame, a tighter frame and an intermediate version. Change framing while keeping other decisions as similar as practical.

step.name: Compare what changes
step.text: 03 Compare what changes Compare what each version communicates. Point to a visible difference that explains your response.

step.name: Choose and explain
step.text: 04 Choose and explain Choose one version and state what you gained and lost. A preference for the spacious image is not required.
